mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, product_id, product_type, number, workshop_id, process_id, team_id, team_leader_name, inbound_quantity, measurement_manner, warehouse_record_id, inbound_time, produce_team_report_id, produce_team_report_time
mapper.select: SELECT mpw.id, mpw.project_id, cp.serial_number AS project_serial_number, cp.short_name AS project_short_name, mpw.monomer_id, pm.name AS monomer_name, mpw.area_id, pa.name AS area_name, CASE mpw.product_type WHEN 2 THEN artifact_type.classification_name WHEN 16 THEN assemble_type.name WHEN 1 THEN machine_part_type.name end as type_name, IFNULL(mpw.inbound_quantity, 0) * IFNULL(mpw.product_net_weight, 0) AS total_net_weight, mpw.product_name, mpw.product_serial_number, mpw.product_specification, mpw.product_material, IFNULL(mpw.inbound_quantity, 0) AS inbound_quantity, mpw.wage, mpw.total_wage, mpw.wage_statistics_mode, mpw.measurement_manner, mpw.measurement_quantity, mpw.process_id, mbp.name as process_name FROM mes_production_wage mpw LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = mpw.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = mpw.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = mpw.area_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON mbp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbp.id = mpw.process_id LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification artifact_type ON artifact_type.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mpw.product_type = 2 AND artifact_type.id = mpw.product_class_id LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config assemble_type ON assemble_type.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mpw.product_type = 16 AND assemble_type.id = mpw.product_class_id LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification machine_part_type ON machine_part_type.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mpw.product_type = 1 AND machine_part_type.id = mpw.product_class_id WHERE mpw.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mpw.bool_confirm = TRUE and mpw.workshop_id = #{workshopId} and mpw.process_id = #{processId} and mpw.team_leader_name = #{teamLeaderName} and date_format(mpw.inbound_time, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
